segments.name: Immunotherapies for cancer
segments.description: Develops targeted immunotherapies for cancer, led by ateganosine, an investigational dual mechanism drug candidate.
segments.evidence: The Company and the Company's chief operating decision-maker, the Company's Chief Executive Officer, view the Company's operations and manage its business as a single operating segment, which is the business of discovering and developing products for the treatment of immunotherapies for cancer.

revenueModel.text: The National Institutes of Health pays research grants, reimbursing allowable costs, to support specific primary research and clinical development projects.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company receives research grants from the National Institutes of Health (NIH) to support specific primary research and clinical development projects.
